name: northwind 1.2.0
body: FICTIONAL. Northwind Agents 1.2.0 adds a stable tool-calling interface and removes the deprecated DeskRetrievalChain. This is a breaking API change for users still on the 0.x retrieval helpers.

name: northwind 1.2.1
body: FICTIONAL. Security advisory CVE-2026-4242: a vulnerability in the tool-calling sandbox is patched. Upgrade before 1 November 2026.
